title: Cover legacy top-level launcher diagnostic overflow and write failure
outcome: Keep test coverage for a long legacy-v1 run-level source mismatch while the launcher still accepts historical source records.
acceptance: A controlled run produces two valid legacy-v1 owner observations whose long mismatch reaches top-level results.error, preserves the actual failing stage exit and records a bounded diagnostic.
A successful diagnostic sidecar and a refused diagnostic write each preserve the terminal result and independent stage logs without invoking a real legacy owner or hashing source files.
